item.subject: science
item.stem:
Wasim wants the density of a small steel nut. He will measure its mass on a digital balance and its volume with a measuring cylinder partly filled with water. He can press tare on the balance and must choose how to read the meniscus.

Which procedure should he follow before using the readings?

options.A: Press tare so the balance reads zero before placing the nut, and read the water level at the bottom of the meniscus.
options.B: Place the nut on the balance straight away, and read the water level at the top of the meniscus.
options.C: Press tare so the balance reads zero before placing the nut, and read the water level at the top of the meniscus.
options.D: Place the nut on the balance straight away, and read the water level at the bottom of the meniscus.
